channel.description: Marco Troisi is a founder, fractional CTO and software architect. Through O2A Labs he helps founders make sound technical decisions and build software that serves the business.

item.title: Useless comments can ruin your code reviews. Here's how to erase them
item.description: Comments can point to inherent problems with code you're reviewing, but many are a waste. Here's how to separate the good from the bad.
